signal: Censia launched a Job Profile Enrichment Assistant on the Workday Marketplace and added a former J&J CHRO to position as the enterprise workforce system of intelligence

email.body1:
Moses, saw Censia launched its Workday Marketplace app and added a former J&J CHRO to lead the enterprise push.

A marketplace launch like that usually opens more in-market enterprise accounts than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Censia off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Moses, quick follow-up for Censia.

With a Workday channel and enterprise positioning, the pipeline target climbs faster than reps can ramp. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Censia needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Moses, last bit of proof for Censia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Censia's reply rate likely compares to other HR-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Moses, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right as a new channel opens, and I know building enterprise coverage is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an HR-tech motion? I will tailor it to Censia either way.
